subject: Using point size as an aesthetic

messages.author: ddc91303cb21ac62
messages.subject: Using point size as an aesthetic
parts:
Hello there,

I am trying to build a plot where the point size corresponds to column
of values like so:

library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(x=runif(8, 1,100),
y <-runif(8, -10,10),
l <-runif(8, 1,8))

ggplot(data, aes(x=x,y=y)) +
geom_point(aes(size=l))

This all works fine except that the smallest point size ends up being
smaller than I want it to be. Can anyone suggest a way to increase the
size of all the points such that the smallest points are so small?

Thanks so much in advance?

messages.subject: Re: Using point size as an aesthetic

Hi:

In the upcoming version of ggplot2 (0.9.0), the syntax for Brandon's
solution will be changed a bit:

## 0.9.0:
ggplot(data, aes(x=x,y=y)) +
geom_point(aes(size=l)) +
scale_size(range = c(5, 15))

Dennis
